correctness.rationale: The line-pair Blaschke–Petkantschin Jacobian is |s1−s2|. The exact circumradius formula forces a width O(1/T), with dominated convergence on a bounded box. The transverse interval length supplies the remaining Vandermonde factors. Its exact unit-cube integral equals 1/30. Sorting and splitting g1g2(g1+g2) yields the stated two normalized Dirichlet components and independent uniform signed transverse coordinate. Disk/square constants independently checked. Exceptional zero denominators and chord endpoints are null sets.
